questions.question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

The Indian team had its __back against the wall,__ but managed to fight back.

options.text: Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape

questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"back against the wall"** means being in a difficult situation with no apparent way out. (मुश्किल स्थिति में फंसना)

 
 
• **Example: **With his back against the wall, John managed to find a way to complete the project on time.
 
 
 
• **"Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape"** means being trapped in a challenging situation with no easy solution. (मुश्किल परिस्थिति में फंसा होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The company found itself stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape after the market crash.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***Stuck in a difficult circumstance with no escape.***

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

This is the first time / I ate such / a tasty cake.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is: **I ate such**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• When referring to an experience that is happening for the **first time**, the **present perfect tense** 'have/has + past participle' should be used.

 
 
• For example, This is the first time I have visited Paris.
 
 
 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'ate' is incorrect.
 
• In the given sentence, it should be **'have eaten'** instead of **'ate'** to match with **'This is the first time'**.
 
• The correct form should be **'This is the first time I have eaten such a tasty cake.'**

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

Correct sentence: *This is the first time **I have eaten** such a tasty cake.*
